title: Inventory a class honestly
prompt:
Inside Solution, define `static class Widget { private int a; private String b; public int c; }` then:
1. `static int declaredFieldCount()` — Widget.class.getDeclaredFields().length
2. `static int accessibleFieldCount()` — Widget.class.getFields().length
3. `static boolean knowsPrivate()` — true iff one of the DECLARED fields is named "a"
(search by name; do not hardcode an index).
4. `static String superName()` — Widget.class.getSuperclass().getName()

tests.name: declared sees everything, accessible sees public
tests.hint: The two inventories differ exactly by visibility.
